v1: `prompts/system_prompt.yaml`
v2: Same file plus one rule (defense strategies only as found in the cases, and whether they worked), followed by rules that prevail over it (v2.6). Six grounding rules: every statement names its case; nothing beyond what the cases state; a statement about several cases only if each supports it; values and outcomes as written; no evaluation or interpretation; say when the cases do not tell. Three quoting rules: after each statement about a case, a literal quote of that case of at most 30 words, copied unchanged; no statement without a quote. Three completeness rules: every part of the question and every main point of each pertinent case; nothing left out for brevity; a closing comparison built on quoted statements
note: The rules were added to reduce statements that the cases do not support (Phase 6.1; v2.5 had the grounding rules and a rule preferring a short answer, at temperature 0).
